transcript.message: Namaskaram Lakshmi garu. I am an AI assistant helping Demo Therapist prepare for Ravi's first session. This call is recorded and only your therapist will read the notes. Do you agree to continue?
Yes, I agree. Avunu, please continue.
Thank you. How old is Ravi now?
He is three years and four months old.
What worries you most about Ravi right now?
He is not talking. He does not look at us and he does not turn when we call his name.
Did Ravi ever use words before?
Yes, at age 2 he said a few words like amma and ball, then he stopped talking. Now he has no words.
Thank you for sharing that. How does he play at home, alone or with other children?
He plays alone and lines up his cars. He does not play with his cousins.
Does he repeat things, or move his hands in a special way?
He repeats lines from cartoons and he flaps his hands when he is excited.
How does he react to loud sounds, or to changes in his routine?
He covers his ears at the mixer and the pressure cooker. If we change the route to school he has a big tantrum.
When he is upset, does he ever hurt himself?
Yes, he hits his own head with his hand when he is upset. Chala bhayam ga untundi.
That sounds hard, thank you for telling me. How are his sleep and eating?
He sleeps late and he eats only rice and curd.
Is there anything in the family that you think your therapist should know?
My younger brother also started talking late. Nothing else.
Thank you Lakshmi garu. I will share these notes with Demo Therapist, who will talk with you at the first session. Goodbye.

analysis.transcript_summary: Parent-reported intake for Ravi (synthetic), age three years four months. The parent consented to the AI assistant and recording. She reports no words now after a few words at age 2, poor eye contact, no response to name, solitary play with lining up of cars, repeated cartoon lines, hand flapping, covering ears at kitchen sounds, tantrums when the school route changes and head hitting when upset.
